scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @autonomy-studio/shared build && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @autonomy-studio/server dev" "pnpm --filter @autonomy-studio/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @autonomy-studio/shared build && pnpm --filter @autonomy-studio/server build && pnpm --filter @autonomy-studio/web build && pnpm run build:manifest
scripts.build:manifest: node scripts/write-manifest.mjs packages/server 0.0.0-dev $(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev) $(node -p process.arch)
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @autonomy-studio/shared build && pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
